claimScope: Demonstrates the evidence system cannot fabricate certainty and that each gate is discriminating. Does NOT verify that any exercise works, is reachable, or is scientifically valid.

results.msg: baseline sandbox validates clean (gates=0) — precondition for every mutation below
[G1] manifest claims a deleted file exists → red (precondition: file existed=true)
[G2] invented sha256 → red (recomputed from bytes, not trusted)
[G6] adapter-consumed source omitted from the manifest → red (FocusExerciseGenerators.kt)
[G11] manifested ACTIVE source is zero bytes → red
[binding] EX1_SPAN_COMPLEJO left only in a comment/string → mechanic VERIFIED_PRESENT→UNRESOLVED
[scope] the same binding planted in a non-mechanism file does not accredit mechanic (VERIFIED_PRESENT→UNRESOLVED)
[G8] retired-seed evidence cited by a current VERIFIED_PRESENT state → red
[scope] omitting FocusGraph.kt → diagnostic changes "no code token for this…" → "mechanism source missing" and the file is listed in missingSources; state stays UNRESOLVED (never a silent false)
[G10] runtime VERIFIED with no snapshot/evidencePath → red (and the real runs alone stay green)
[G9] VERIFIED_ABSENT with a self-asserted exhaustive:true and no exhaustivenessEvidenceId → red
[G13] two axes on one observation presented as independent → red
[C2] design-only (19) and truly-unassigned (37) are separate states; collapsing them reproduces the old 56 bucket
[G12] auxiliary "CheckIn" placed in a target slot → invariant violation
[C3] blockReachability=VERIFIED_PRESENT does NOT accredit exerciseRoute=UNRESOLVED; neither is a component axis (folded=false); the block record is identical across 13 FOCUS ids
production sources intact after the suite (all mutations ran in sandboxes; nothing written to the repo)
